messages:
alex.k: Hey team — customer reported repeated 502/504s from the hosted API during streaming after we rolled a billing-header change. They see responses cut off mid-token. Request id: req_8a3f. Seen spike ~2026-03-17T11:42:00-07:00.

maria.s: Can you paste the minimal repro + any x-request-id/x-envoy-upstream info? Also which model/route?

alex.k: Repro curl attached. Hitting ~40-60% 502s locally when targeting the customer tenant. Route: /v1/stream/generate.
```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer tok_xyz" -H "X-Billing-Tenant: acct-444" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"redwood/gpt-stream","input":"hello world","stream":true}' https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/stream/generate
```

Response example: HTTP/2 502
server: envoy
x-request-id: req_8a3f
x-envoy-upstream-service-time: 312

henry-sre: Thanks. Two quick suspects: (1) ingress connection pool / HTTP2 stream window starving on the upstream auth/billing inject proxy, (2) auth service latency causing Envoy to close streams. Can you dump envoy access/error lines for req_8a3f?

alex.k: Added logs snippet below (truncated):
```
[2026-03-17T18:42:11Z] "POST /v1/stream/generate HTTP/2" 502 - - "req_8a3f" - upstream_reset before response
[2026-03-17T18:42:12Z] error connecting to upstream: connection reset by peer
[2026-03-17T18:42:12Z] upstream host: midproxy-2.prod (10.23.45.67):503, active_conn: 198/200
```

support-l2: Those active_conn numbers look suspiciously close to pool max. Any recent change to billing-header middleware?

maria.s: We shipped billing header injection change in canary last night that added a round-trip to auth/billing to validate tenant quota per stream. If auth calls block, Envoy may hit upstream_conn limits and return 502/504.

henry-sre: Mitigation steps: (a) increase ingress upstream_conn_pool to 300 for midproxy cluster for 30m, (b) enable short-circuit auth cache on the billing proxy for streaming routes, (c) add retry-on-5xx with small backoff for streaming open requests. I'll apply (a) now.

oncall-bot: ALERT: hostedapi.edge.502_rate increased from 0.2% -> 3.8% in 5m window. Auto-escalation to eng-sre triggered.

alex.k: After bumping pool to 300, my local repro dropped to ~5% 502s (from 50%). Leaving monitoring on.

maria.s: For long term: we should: (1) change billing validation to async/queued for stream initialization, (2) add metrics for auth latency per-stream, (3) add envoy circuit for auth dependency to avoid head-of-line. I'll open a follow-up RFC.

henry-sre: Filed a temporary runbook step: if 502 rate > 1% for 10m, autoscale midproxy pods + bump pool and toggle auth-cache. Noting owners: @maria.s for billing change, @eng-runtime for proxy hardening.

support-l2: Customer notified with interim mitigation and asked to validate next 2 hours. :thumbsup:

alex.k: Thanks everyone — keeping thread open, will post if anything regresses.
